command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p wh && mv ./*.whl wh/ && (cd wh && sha256sum -c ../wheels.sha256) \
  || { echo "FAIL: a staged wheel does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== pytest from the staged wheels, offline (the env ships the tests but not pytest) =="
python3 -m pip install -q --no-index --find-links wh --no-deps wh/*.whl 2>&1 | grep -v "not on PATH" | tail -2
python3 -c "import pytest, xdist; print('pytest', pytest.__version__, ' pytest-xdist', xdist.__version__)" \
  || { echo "FAIL: pytest did not install from the staged wheels"; exit 1; }

echo "== scikit-learn's own installed-package test model (build_tools/wheels/test_wheels.sh) =="
python3 -c "import sklearn; sklearn.show_versions()" > show.txt 2>&1; cat show.txt
N=$(python3 -c "import joblib; print(joblib.cpu_count(only_physical_cores=True))")
# Count collection in a SEPARATE process, so "every test is accounted for" is a check between
# two counts rather than one log agreeing with itself. (-q suppresses xdist's item count.)
export PYTHONPATH=/tmp
ACCOUNT_OUT=collect.json python3 -m pytest --pyargs sklearn --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider -p account > collect.log 2>&1
T0=$(date +%s)
ACCOUNT_OUT=run.json python3 -u -m pytest --pyargs sklearn -n "$N" -p no:cacheprovider -p account -q -rs --durations=10 > suite.log 2>&1
RC=$?
WALL=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
echo "suite exit $RC, ${WALL}s on $N workers"

python3 -u - "$RC" "$WALL" "$N" <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tee suite-summary.txt
import re, sys, json, collections
rc, wall, n = int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
log = open("suite.log", errors="replace").read()
col, run = json.load(open("collect.json")), json.load(open("run.json"))
items, cskips = col["items"], col["collect_skips"]
summ = [l for l in log.splitlines() if re.search(r"\d+ (passed|failed)", l) and " in " in l]
counts = collections.Counter()
for num, kind in re.findall(r"(\d+) (passed|failed|skipped|xfailed|xpassed|errors?)", summ[-1] if summ else ""):
    counts["errors" if kind.startswith("error") else kind] += int(num)
print("suite_items        %d collected, %d unique (separate --collect-only), run on %s workers" % (len(items), len(set(items)), n))
for k in ("passed", "skipped", "xfailed", "xpassed", "failed", "errors"):
    print("suite_%-12s %d" % (k, counts[k]))
print("suite_wall_s       %s" % wall)
# One counted outcome per item: the call report, or a setup/teardown report that did not pass.
per = collections.defaultdict(int)
for nid, when, outcome in run["reports"]:
    if when == "call" or outcome != "passed":
        per[nid] += 1
ids = set(items)
missing = [i for i in items if per.get(i, 0) == 0]
extra = [i for i in per if i not in ids]
multi = [i for i, k in per.items() if k != 1]
summary_total = sum(counts[k] for k in ("passed", "skipped", "xfailed", "xpassed", "failed", "errors"))
print("suite_accounting   %d items -> %d with exactly one outcome; %d missing, %d uncollected, %d multiple"
      % (len(items), sum(1 for i in items if per.get(i) == 1), len(missing), len(extra), len(multi)))
print("suite_summary_sum  %d = %d items + %d collection-time skip(s) %s"
      % (summary_total, len(items), len(cskips), ", ".join(c[:60] for c in cskips)))
fails = []
if rc != 0: fails.append("pytest exited %d" % rc)
if counts["failed"]: fails.append("%d tests FAILED" % counts["failed"])
if counts["errors"]: fails.append("%d ERRORS" % counts["errors"])
if len(set(items)) != len(items): fails.append("duplicate collected ids")
if missing: fails.append("%d collected tests never reported, e.g. %s" % (len(missing), missing[0][:100]))
if extra: fails.append("%d reports for tests that were not collected" % len(extra))
if multi: fails.append("%d tests reported more than one outcome" % len(multi))
if summary_total != len(items) + len(cskips):
    fails.append("summary %d != %d items + %d collection-time skips" % (summary_total, len(items), len(cskips)))
# A floor against a collapsing collection: 47,445 items on this pin.
if len(items) < 47000: fails.append("only %d items collected; this pin collects 47,445" % len(items))
reasons = collections.Counter()
for num, why in re.findall(r"SKIPPED \[(\d+)\] [^:]+:\d+: (.*)", log):
    reasons[re.sub(r"\d+", "N", why)[:90]] += int(num)
print("top skip reasons (so the skips are explained, not waved through):")
for why, k in reasons.most_common(8):
    print("  %6d  %s" % (k, why))
if fails:
    print("FAIL: " + "; ".join(fails)); sys.exit(1)
print("SUITE OK")
PYEOF
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: scikit-learn's own suite did not pass cleanly"; tail -40 suite.log; exit 1; }

echo "== closed forms, a cross-code MLE, planted truth =="
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'SKLEARN IDENTITIES OK' identities.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
